title: PROJECT MPG: TOWARDS A GENERALIZED PERFORMANCE BENCHMARK FOR LLM CAPABILITIES
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating LLM capabilities through 'Factual Recall', 'Problem Solving', and 'Social Sensitivity' (specifically bias related to race, sexual orientation, and socioeconomic status). While it includes 'business_ethics' in a correlation matrix of external benchmarks in the appendix, the core proposed benchmark (MPG) does not include a component for evaluating religion, morals, or ethics.
